objective: Synthesize the verified/scar-bearing DiGe C/H lineage into one source-level internal S1 human-system candidate using the canonical DEUS prototypes as evaluator/engineering targets, not as pixels or external image-generation inputs.

prototype_inputs.step02: continuous mesh + surface blockout / unified topology / silhouette continuity
prototype_inputs.step04: face + hands articulation / eyelid-jaw-lips interfaces / neutral pose
prototype_inputs.step06: cloth layer + deformation / tank top + leggings / body contact
prototype_inputs.step07: hair strand system + groom / layered bun / scalp flow / flyaways
prototype_inputs.step09: PBR skin + cloth + area lighting / material response

synthesis_rules: Identity/body stays deterministic source-level geometry; no image-space identity repair.
H-line contributes locality and artifact-avoidance principles only; no H image pixels are composited.
Eyes use native GNM geometry with topology-independent generated-coordinate iris/pupil and real cornea/wetline interfaces.
Skin uses actual GNM face material with restrained SSS, regional roughness, meso/pore/micro normal; semantic UV nearest-transfer is forbidden.
Hair uses scalp-rooted layered system: dark scalp coverage mass + dense thin tangential undercoat + deep gather + rounded bun + sparse baby/flyaway layers; long01 is not a final-style prior.
Cloth becomes explicit gray tank + gray leggings source-level shell with procedural fabric PBR; helper body-suit is not final presentation.
Camera contract: 50mm full-body multiview + 85mm portrait hero; same subject origin/scale.
Studio area lighting must reveal material response without beauty-patch postprocess.
Hands remain neutral/rest in S1; no articulation-range claim unless separately executed.

runtime_gate.device: CPU unless a fresh admitted GPU receipt exists

visual_gate: hairline continuous and irregular, no comb/radial spike/helmet artifact
eyes embedded in lids with readable iris/pupil and restrained sclera
skin visibly material-responsive with pores/meso detail without plastic/chalk read
tank/leggings read as fabric and follow body without full-body helper-suit look
full-body silhouette and ground contact remain plausible
truth_boundary: S1 is endogenous only if the selected GNM identity is rebuilt from source-level model state and renderer receipts show zero external image generation and zero prototype/reference-pixel read/composite. Prototype boards are evaluator/engineering targets only. Runtime PASS does not equal visual PASS or hyperreal certification.

GNM scan-learned head + semantic adult female Asian prior + prototype-driven face-plane correction
winner_matrix.prototype_target: Step02/04 same coherent adult DEUS subject

winner_matrix.kept: regional face masks, local-only repair principle, reduced sclera, native embedded eye, generated-coordinate iris, no image patch
winner_matrix.prototype_target: Step04 eyelid/jaw/lips articulation and natural eye interface

winner_matrix.kept: physical strands, irregular microhair, guide-gated scalp roots, updo decomposition, tangential flow, dense follicle undercoat
object-space scale, mature PBR discipline, controlled lighting, regional roughness/color, dermal multiscale detail, meso relief
winner_matrix.prototype_target: Step09 layered skin BRDF with pores, SSS, roughness and natural highlights

winner_matrix.kept: production body contact shell split into tank + leggings with procedural fabric PBR
winner_matrix.prototype_target: Step06 tank/leggings fit, contact, stretch/compression visual behavior

winner_matrix.kept: photometric discipline, RAW/AOV same-seed audit, 50mm body views, executed 85mm portrait, neutral area-light studio
winner_matrix.prototype_target: Step09 area lighting + Step02/06/07 multiview comparability

winner_matrix.kept: hash/manifest binding, fail-closed runtime, recovery scars, micro-render evidence architecture
winner_matrix.prototype_target: comparison must be reproducible; no heuristic-only promotion

prototype_compare_plan.before_render: Select semantic GNM identity from a bounded seed set using prototype-derived landmark ratios only; never read or composite prototype pixels in the renderer.
after_render: Step02: compare full-body front/profile/3-4/back silhouette and mesh continuity.
Step04: compare neutral face/eye/lip/jaw interface and relaxed hands; do not claim unexecuted expression/finger range.
Step06: compare tank/leggings silhouette, body contact and visible fabric behavior; dynamic squat/lunge remains outside S1 unless separately executed.
Step07: compare bun silhouette, scalp-to-strand flow, hairline irregularity, clump hierarchy, fringe/baby/flyaway layers in front/side/back.
Step09: compare skin/cloth material response, highlight/roughness behavior and area-light falloff.
prototype_compare_plan.promotion_rule: Hard subsystem gates dominate any aggregate score. S1 may be retained as the best endogenous candidate even if it remains below prototype/hyperreal bar.
